title: Halo Dental button
description: Sharp 4px-radius rectangular buttons in Halo's industrial hardware style: vermilion orange primary with black text, solid white, crisp 1px dark or light outlines, quiet stone secondary, split icon+label video CTA, and square icon/locale buttons.
notes: uses rounded-md (4px in halodental-theme) to match Halo's crisp rectangular UI chrome
name: halodental-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders an anchor when provided, otherwise a button element

props.name: variant
props.description:
primary: vermilion fill with ink text · solid-inverse: foreground fill with background text (e.g. white button on dark header) ·
outline: 1px foreground border · secondary: quiet stone/charcoal surface · icon-card: 32px white square with outward arrow

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 38px tall · md: 42px tall · lg: 48px tall · square: 40x40px utility square

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: optional leading icon box (as on the mobile "Play the video" button)

props.name: external
props.description: shows a subtle outward arrow after the label

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: accessible label when rendering an icon-only button

props.name: type
props.description: button type attribute when not a link
